% Images are generated by generateFigure.py (pvbatch) in each case directory.

\newcommand{\panel}[2]{%
  \begin{minipage}[t]{0.49\linewidth}
    \centering
    {\small\textbf{#1}}\\[1pt]
    \includegraphics[width=\linewidth]{#2}
  \end{minipage}}
